question: ICC (International Cricket Council) has named which of the following cricketers as the captain of its Men's T20 and ODI Team of the Decade in December 2020?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points

__
 
• The famous Mahendra Singh Dhoni was named **captain of ICC's ODI and T20 **International teams of the decade.
 
• The ICC's ODI team of the decade commanded by Dhoni includes star Indian batsmen **Rohit and Virat.** 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni is an Indian former executive cricketer who was captain of the Indian national cricket team in limited-overs formats from **2007 to 2017 and in Test cricket from 2008 to 2014.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905e7f57d2f246938c15dbbf23c5d6111143f69d78874a6f8c3e07235a713cbd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Virat Kohli** is an Indian global cricketer and **previous captain of the India national cricket team.**
 
• **David Warner** is an Australian international cricketer and a previous captain of the Australian national team in limited overs format and as well a **former test vice-captain.** 
 
• **Rohit Gurunath Sharma** is an Indian global cricketer who is the **present captain of the Indian national cricket team.**
